text:
lina: Heads up — eu2 rack-18 NIC flaps caused cross-tenant egress spikes ~3x p95 for affected tenants. Saw a ton of retransmits and weird hairpinning between pods on the same host. I'm dumping pcaps now and looking at offloads.
aj: Oof. Any correlation with last night's firmware rollout?
lina: Possible — rack-18 units got FW v2.4.1 at 02:10UTC. I captured pcap + `ethtool -k` output from one host, sending to #eng-infra-telemetry channel.
devin: Quick check: looks like RX/TX offload state mismatch + SNAT rules causing packets to go out and come back through the NIC. Kernel bounce shows up as host-to-host traffic even for intra-node flows.
racheal: That's the same rack that had a slow warmup anomaly last month, right?
aj: Yeah. Same hardware batch. We toggled fastpath offload for a subset during rollouts as a mitigation  — maybe config drift.
ops-bot: Alert: egress-throttle applied to rack-18 by aj at 6298765440 — soft limit 200Mbps/host.
lina: Thanks. Can we try a temporary tc qdisc filter on the top talkers so we avoid wider tenant fallout?
devin: Suggested quick throttle (one-liner):
```
# limit noisy tenant IPs on host
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:1 htb rate 1gbit
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1:1 classid 1:10 htb rate 200mbit ceil 200mbit
tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1:0 prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.40.12.0/24 flowid 1:10
```
This is invasive but quick; we can script apply across hosts.
aj: I'm running a canary on host-18-03 now. Initial metrics look better — egress p95 dropped ~45% on that host.
lina: Nice. Next step: move the top noisy tenant (nlp-corp) to a dedicated micro-slice in the eu2 edge pool so they stop affecting shared lanes. Can we do live rebind?
devin: We have hot-rebind support for slices. Sequence: mark allocation warm, drain new slice, reattach tenant, then scale down old. Expect ~90s of connection churn.
racheal: Heads-up: moving them to dedicated increases committed capacity. Cost estimate from finance: ~ $1.8k/mo for two reserved slices in eu2.
sam-finance: Confirmed — rough delta ~ $1.8k/mo (reserved + monitoring). Recommend short term absorption; flag for product review.
aj: I'll open a short-lived routing rule to prefer dedicated for nlp-corp and schedule the rebind during the low window at 15:00UTC.
lina: After rebind, we should audit FW offload config across rack-18 and roll back to stable toggles if mismatch persists. Also add a probe to detect SNAT hairpin pattern automatically.
devin: Agreed — will add a lightweight detector that looks for host-originated flows with destination that resolves back to the same rack within the flow window.
racheal: Can ops put a ticket to add the detector to the egress alerting playbook? Also add a cost tag so finance is notified when we do emergency dedicated carveouts.
aj: Ticket created: INFRA-8241. I'll push the rebind plan and update status here after canary completes. 
lina: Thanks — will keep monitoring. If the canary remains green for 10m we proceed. :thumbsup:
